_doc: Platinum's story beats in the order the player meets them, per chapter (notes/PLATINUM_CHAPTERS.md), for b2tools/platinum_flow_check.py (its docstring says what each key does). A beat: zone (Pearl's MAP_ name without MAP_), one of trigger N / frame N / talk N (Platinum's local id) / script N (Platinum's script numbers of the zone's file), optional at [x, z] (where the player stands), set {name: value} (a menu's answer, gender), expect "off" (must not play then), what (plain words), chapter (a beat of another chapter run here to check what it needs from this one), repeats (a guard that turns the player back each time), must (what it must leave: NAME, NAME=v, ITEM:n, BADGE:n, T:PTRAINER_n, POKETCH). The start is the chapter's Test start in notes/PLATINUM_CHAPTERS.md unless start overrides it. (plat-ch8) warp [x, z] with to ZONE: after the zone's map scripts, the first warp still on that tile leads to ZONE (the lakes' stacked warps); needs: names printed when it fails. (plat-ch9) restart B: the state becomes the chapter's second test start ("**Test start B**" in its section of notes/PLATINUM_CHAPTERS.md), its tile checked; the beats after it run from there.
